artifacts.name: test_capture_uses_acceptance_red_when_validate_commands_are_green
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has one green validate command and one acceptance command that exits 1 for the intended behavior failure.

expected.behavior: Capture records both commands, marks command_source validate_and_acceptance, and reports valid red evidence.

artifacts.name: test_capture_skips_acceptance_when_validate_already_has_red
artifacts.source_scenario: A validate command exits 1 while an acceptance command would create an observable marker if executed.

expected.behavior: Capture returns validate-only red evidence and the acceptance marker is absent.

artifacts.name: test_capture_does_not_mask_invalid_validate_with_acceptance_red
artifacts.source_scenario: A validate command exits 2 and an acceptance command would exit 1.

expected.behavior: Capture remains invalid and does not execute the acceptance command.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_passes_e707_command_integrity
artifacts.source_scenario: A lock saves marked evidence captured from one green validate command and one red acceptance command, then plan-lock enforcement runs.

expected.behavior: Required plan-lock and red-evidence enforcement pass without E707.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_missing_acceptance_command_fails_e707
artifacts.source_scenario: Marked validate_and_acceptance evidence is spliced to omit the locked acceptance command.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_cross_layer_swap_fails_e707
artifacts.source_scenario: Marked evidence retains its original command order while the locked contract snapshot swaps the validate and acceptance commands.

expected.behavior: Enforcement fails with RED_EVIDENCE_COMMAND_MISMATCH even though the flattened combined command multiset is unchanged.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_without_acceptance_snapshot_fails_e707
artifacts.source_scenario: Marked validate_and_acceptance evidence is paired with a lock contract whose acceptance_commands snapshot is missing.

expected.behavior: Enforcement fails closed with RED_EVIDENCE_COMMAND_MISMATCH instead of applying legacy validate-only tolerance.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_without_contract_snapshot_fails_e707
artifacts.source_scenario: Marked validate_and_acceptance evidence is paired with a lock whose entire _manifest_contract snapshot is missing.

expected.behavior: Enforcement fails closed with RED_EVIDENCE_COMMAND_MISMATCH because marked evidence cannot receive legacy snapshot tolerance.

artifacts.name: test_acceptance_red_evidence_with_unknown_command_source_fails_e707
artifacts.source_scenario: A captured lock is tampered to use an unsupported non-null command_source while its validate evidence is also spliced, and repository-scope enforcement treats the manifest as unchanged.

expected.behavior: Enforcement fails unconditionally with RED_EVIDENCE_COMMAND_MISMATCH rather than relying on changed-manifest E705 validity checks.

artifacts.name: test_legacy_validate_only_evidence_remains_valid_with_acceptance_contract
artifacts.source_scenario: An existing unmarked lock has validate-only red evidence and the manifest also declares acceptance commands.

expected.behavior: The historical lock remains valid and does not receive E707.

artifacts.name: test_legacy_validate_only_evidence_without_contract_snapshot_remains_valid
artifacts.source_scenario: An unmarked validate-only evidence lock predates the entire _manifest_contract snapshot.

expected.behavior: Legacy unmarked evidence retains historical snapshot tolerance and remains valid while the manifest hash still matches.

artifacts.name: test_capture_runs_all_acceptance_commands_and_rejects_invalid_exit
artifacts.source_scenario: Fast validate is green, the first acceptance command exits 1, and a later acceptance command exits 2.

expected.behavior: Both acceptance commands run and aggregate evidence is invalid rather than accepting the earlier red exit.

artifacts.name: test_preserve_acceptance_red_evidence_accepts_unchanged_commands
artifacts.source_scenario: A marked validate_and_acceptance lock is explicitly revised with --preserve-red-evidence while both command lists are unchanged.

expected.behavior: Revision succeeds and preserves the exact marked evidence payload.

artifacts.name: test_preserve_acceptance_red_evidence_rejects_changed_acceptance_commands
artifacts.source_scenario: A marked validate_and_acceptance lock is explicitly revised with --preserve-red-evidence after its acceptance command changes.

expected.behavior: Revision refuses without modifying the lock because the acceptance command multiset no longer matches.

artifacts.name: test_preserve_acceptance_red_evidence_rejects_cross_layer_swap
artifacts.source_scenario: A marked lock's current manifest swaps its validate and acceptance commands before explicit --preserve-red-evidence revision.

expected.behavior: Revision refuses without modifying the lock because command identity is bound separately to each layer.

artifacts.name: test_preserve_acceptance_red_evidence_accepts_reordering_within_layers
artifacts.source_scenario: A marked lock has two validate and two acceptance commands whose order changes only within each original layer.

expected.behavior: Revision succeeds and preserves evidence because integrity comparison is order-insensitive inside each layer.

artifacts.name: test_cypress_suffixes_are_test_files
artifacts.source_scenario: The shared classifier receives conventional Cypress TypeScript and JavaScript basenames alongside a non-test source basename.

expected.behavior: All four .cy.* test suffixes are accepted and the ordinary source file is rejected.

artifacts.name: command_source
artifacts.description: Identifies evidence captured from validate plus acceptance commands; null preserves the historical validate-only evidence shape.

artifacts.name: capture_red_phase_evidence
artifacts.description: Captures fast validate evidence first, then falls back to acceptance commands only when every fast command is green; marked fallback evidence remains command-bound through E707.

artifacts.name: enforce_plan_locks
artifacts.description: Keeps legacy validate-only command integrity while binding validate_and_acceptance evidence to both locked command snapshots.

artifacts.name: is_test_file
artifacts.description: Recognizes standard Cypress .cy.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx basenames in addition to existing test conventions.

artifacts.name: cmd_plan_revise
artifacts.description: Allows explicit preservation of valid validate_and_acceptance evidence only when both locked and current validate plus acceptance command multisets remain unchanged.
